description: Fundraising, not selling: use this when the person is raising money and asks which investors to talk to. Finds up to 3 VC firms investing now in companies like theirs, each with a recent deal or stated focus and a link to the page it came from (a live web search, about 30 seconds). Only firms with sourced evidence are returned. Paid. Check the price with quote before running.

arrRange.description: Current ARR range (e.g., "$0-$500K", "$500K-$2M", "$2M-$10M"). Infer or ask.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional: any unique string for this call. Retrying with the same key returns the first result and never charges twice.

maxAmountCents.description: Optional: the most this call may cost, in cents. If the price is higher, nothing runs and nothing is charged.

productDescription.description: What the company does and who it serves. Infer from conversation context if the user has already described their product.

quoteId.description: Optional: the quote_id from quote, to pay the quoted price (held for 30 minutes).

stage.description: Current funding stage. Infer from context if mentioned.

vertical.description: Industry vertical (e.g., "AI/ML", "FinTech", "HealthTech", "SaaS"). Infer from product description.

name: get_thesis_match
title: Find investors who fit
